description: Upload an image file to a TGC folder for use in a game component. This is a heavyweight operation — avoid calling repeatedly in quick succession. Requires authentication.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the image file on disk. Provide either file_path or url, not both.

filename.description: Optional filename to use in TGC (max 255 chars). Required when uploading from URL. Defaults to the original filename when uploading from disk.

folder_id.description: The folder ID to upload the file into. Components have associated folder IDs.

url.description: Public URL of the image to download and upload to TGC. Provide either url or file_path, not both.

name: upload_file
